sampler.control_method: seeded legal playout; reused validated control sampler

evaluation.policy: legal-action masked softmax over raw logits
evaluation.value: child value converted to root-player perspective; terminal children exact +/-1

classification.prevents_immediate_loss: opponent has immediate win before action, none after
classification.allows_immediate_loss: opponent has immediate win both before and after action
classification.creates_immediate_loss: no immediate opponent win before action, one exists after
classification.no_immediate_terminal_consequence: nonterminal child and no immediate opponent winning reply
